c: Bat Country is the fourth challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by reaching level 80 in Inverse
Alternatively, Bat Country can be unlocked in the
As the name of the stage implies, waves are comprised entirely of bat enemies, including many unique variants of
Enemies grow stronger over time on Bat Country, with their Max Health increasing by an additional 10% per minute and their Movement Speed by an additional 1.25% every minute. This effect stacks with
XP bonus, meaning the player actually collects less experience.
cannot drop from light sources in this stage.

, three pressure plates labeled "A", "B" and "C" will appear on further visits to the stage, due north of starting area, marked as a "?" on the map. Stepping on them each toggles a background effect; this effect is only visual and has no impact on gameplay.
The hyper mode for this stage is unlocked by default after unlocking the stage.
Hyper mode in Bat Country has +80%
The following items can be found in this stage:
s appears to the northeast of the starting area on further visits to the stage after collecting both Relics on this stage. Approaching them will cause 9 Sun Atlanteans to spawn.
has no effect on this stage.

Two relics are located in Bat Country. Each one of them appears at the center of a large square of Diamonds on a given time and disappears after one minute has passed. When they disappear or are picked up, they can continue to appear on the map and even move on it, even though they are no longer on the field.
Enemies in Bat Country approach from all four sides of the player.
NOTE: As official sources name only a few of the enemies, unit names are mostly made up based on their internal IDs and are subject to change.
